docs.summary: Dock window for editing a texture's sprites. Sprite config lives in the texture's `.meta` (via [`TextureSpriteMeta`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Importers.TextureSpriteMeta)). In Multiple mode the canvas is a full authoring surface (drag to make rects, move/resize, slice); in Single mode there is one fixed full-texture rect and only the border + pivot are editable. Rects use corner + whole-edge resize handles, green border handles, and a draggable pivot. All edits are undoable; Save writes the meta and reimports.
Opens the sprite editor dock panel for the given texture GUID, creating a new window instance and loading the texture's sprite settings.
Serializes the texture GUID into the state JSON object. Returns false if no texture is loaded.
Restores the texture GUID from the state JSON object and loads the corresponding sprite editor target.
